gaps.lighting: The warm back-lit key at el 8.9 is right, but the golden-hour shade is still crushed: the hero shadow band measures luma 25 against 152 on sunlit paving (about 50:1 in linear light, where the bible asks for a 5:1 fill). Walkers show no readable contact or long shadows at low sun (hero, phone_hud).
gaps.time_of_day: Night is now clearly better: towers go dark with lit windows, the lamp-pole glow is fixed (pole luma 137 -> 59) and the bridge lighting reflects well. But the lit windows merge into large cream blocks with no floor-slab breaks or per-window variance, so the towers read as Tetris blocks (hero_night). Noon is still flat grey (hero_noon).
gaps.palette: Blue bitumen (street_sgt and shops road RGB 43/50/68, B-R +25), royal-blue CBD glass (street_sgt, bridge_skyline) and a lilac horizon (river_cbd, mends). These differ from the warm olive, amber and teal palette of the bible and of eq2 and kpview.
gaps.materials: The EQ paving is 0.6 x 0.3 m in three high-contrast tones, so it reads as a car-park block grid (hero_noon checker, hero). The water shows brushed horizontal streaks instead of patchy wind slicks (river_cbd, mends). Shopfronts read as grey roller doors (street_sgt, shops).
gaps.vegetation: Kings Park clump stems leave about 3-4 m of bare pole under each crown, so the foreground reads as a field of telegraph poles. Shore lawns carry pale lollipop euc2 trees (kings_park), and the park is bald grey-olive at range (aerial). This is the 6th round at 5.
gaps.architecture: Mid-range CBD towers are flat extruded prisms with no crowns, setbacks or roof plant (bridge_skyline, aerial). Night window runs form multi-cell blocks (hero_night). Podiums are all roller-door bands (street_sgt).
gaps.characters: The promenade population fell from 4 to 2 visible walkers in hero, hero_noon and hero_night. The green-shirt female clone is still in every hero frame.
gaps.composition: The player box is on target (x 0.401, h 32.7%). The hero upper-left quarter is still empty sky with no framing palm, and the hottest value is the sun pool on the paving at camera-right, not the player or the arches (hero, phone_hud).
gaps.atmosphere: The sky and clouds are good (river_cbd, hero). The far skyline is still ghosted (mends tower-vs-sky dL 19.7, r7 18.3), and the aerial reads as a uniform cream haze with no depth layering.
gaps.ui: The HUD health and stamina bars stay full strength at rest, over the far shore (phone_hud). The calm-fade fix has not landed for the third round.
gaps.mobile: phone_hud is pixel-identical to r7 apart from one walker. The frame is sparse, and the right touch cluster (SPRINT/PUNCH/ENTER) covers the only busy part of the promenade.
gaps.artefacts: A palm trunk fills the hero_back foreground in front of the player, with a hot bloom fringe (reported removed after capture, so verify). The near-plane white column at the right edge of shops is still there, and the water still has brushed stripes. The melted bus is gone from street_sgt.
gaps.real_game: The hero promenade is close to screenshot-worthy. Every street view (street_sgt, shops) is empty asphalt with no near traffic, no parked cars and almost no people, which reads as a tech demo.

measurements.note_unchanged: 8 of 12 views are within 0.4% of r7. Only the night facade, the lamp-pole fade, the ped population and the hero_back palm changed visibly.

cost.note: r8 tris and calls include a forced shadow pass. Re-measure phone_hud without it before accepting the ~2.0M main-pass claim.

regressions.what: The EQ promenade lost half its walkers: 4 -> 2 visible in hero, hero_noon and hero_night (the clearView/prime changes relocate people out of the frame). The green-shirt clone is still the one that remains.
hero_back: a Washingtonia trunk 2-3 m in front of the camera hides the player's left side and carries a bloom fringe. Reported removed after capture; the next round must confirm it.
street_sgt: the melted bus was removed, but no near traffic replaced it. The street is now empty to the vanishing point (3 sub-10 px cars, 1 walker).
Cost: hero +1.94M tris and +122 calls, hero_back +1.98M tris, phone_hud +1.51M tris and +119 calls. This is partly the forced shadow pass and is unverified for the main pass.
Night towers no longer read beige, but they now show large uniform cream blocks with no floor lines (a new blocky look).

fixes.problem: CBD streets are empty: street_sgt has no car within 150 m and shops has one. Cost went down, but visible life went down with it (the 4th round that streets read as a demo).
fixes.fix: (1) Static parked cars: in traffic.js, at create, walk every lane of class 't' or 's' roads inside the CBD box x -450..650, z -900..-150. Every 7.5 m on the kerb-side lane, offset (r.w/2 - 1.1) m toward the kerb, place a car with p = 0.55. Skip points within 12 m of a junction (nextLane end points) or of a bus stop. Build one InstancedMesh per unique KINDS body (sedan, hatch, suv, ute; no bus) with per-instance colour from CAR_COLORS, castShadow only inside SHADOW_R. Cost about +4 calls (+4 shadow), max 160 instances. (2) T.prime: select candidates in camera space, not from the focus: depth = dot(q - cp, cf) in 25..200 m, |lateral| < 0.55*depth, replacing 'dist < 15 || dist > 180' and the 40 m camera test. Placed cap ceil(target*0.8) -> target. (3) Lane spacing check 14 -> 9 m (cars.some(...) < 14 in both spawn and prime).
